name: Chatto
description: Chatto is a privacy-first team and group chat app built for self-hosting. It runs as a single binary with an embedded NATS/JetStream store, so it needs no external database, and supports voice and video calls and screensharing through an optional LiveKit server.

notes.text: Register the first account in the web UI, or run cd /opt/chatto && ./chatto operator user create --login <name>. Logins such as root, admin, op and operator are blocked.
Set SMTP credentials and a public webserver.url in /opt/chatto_data/chatto.toml before using Chatto in production.
Voice and video calls need a separately deployed LiveKit server, configured in the [livekit] section of chatto.toml.
